title: Latvian temporary residence, for up to two years, for an investment in a company's share capital (EUR 50,000 or EUR 100,000, plus EUR 10,000 to the state budget)

sources.title: Immigration Law, 27. pants (1) 10): up to two years for EUR 50,000 or EUR 100,000 invested in a company's share capital and EUR 10,000 paid to the state budget; the company's size and yearly taxes
Immigration Law, 27. pants (3): in the cases of the first part a family member of the foreigner may also request a temporary residence permit for the term of the foreigner's permit
Immigration Law, 1. pants (1) 8), family member (ģimenes loceklis): the spouse, the minor children of the third-country national or of the spouse (wards included) and persons under curatorship
Immigration Law, 27. pants (7) and (8): a citizen of Belarus, and a citizen of the Russian Federation, has no right to request a temporary residence permit under point 10 of the first part
Immigration Law, 1. pants (1) 21) and 29) and 2. pants: a third-country national holds no EU, EEA or Swiss citizenship; the law sets the entry and residence of third-country nationals
Immigration Law, 29. pants (1) to (3): a repeated permit within 90 days of the last one's end; an adult child who was a minor at the first request may ask too; after five years, EUR 2,000
Immigration Law, 33. pants (1) 1), (4) and (6): an answer within 30 days, or up to four months of receiving the documents for objective reasons; the permit is made in 10 working days, or in two
Immigration Law, 28. pants: the Cabinet may suspend the issue of permits under 27. pants (1) 10) for up to five years for nationals of the third countries it names
Cabinet Regulations No. 731 of 2024 on the state fee for migration services, points 3 and 5.1: a call EUR 17 (EUR 10 online) plus EUR 10 a person; examining a permit request EUR 160, 280 or 560
Civil Law, Part One (family law): art. 219, minority lasts until the age of 18; arts. 220 and 221, a minor may be declared of age from 16, and a person who married before 18 is of age
Law on the Protection of the Rights of the Child, 3. pants (1): a child is a person under 18, except one declared of age or married before 18
Immigration Law, 30. pants: the payments under 27. pants (1) 10) and 29. pants (3) are made once and are not refunded, except in the cases the Cabinet sets
Immigration Law, 25. pants (1): a request for a temporary residence permit needs a call (izsaukums), except in the cases listed, such as the sole officer of a registered company who may represent it
Immigration Law, 32. pants (1): where the documents for a residence permit may be filed
Immigration Law, 34. pants (1) 4), 5), 7), 8) and 26): a permit is refused for lack of means, a dangerous illness, an entry ban, a conviction or the company's tax debt above EUR 150

Immigration Law, transitional provision 3: until new Cabinet regulations take effect, and until 1 December 2027 at the latest, the listed earlier regulations apply where they do not contradict the law
Cabinet Regulations No. 564 of 2010, Residence Permit Regulations: the call (points 7 and 13), the documents (28, 29, 39 to 41), renewal taxes (65, 65.1), receiving it and the refund (72 to 75)
Cabinet Regulations No. 225 of 2017 on the financial means a foreigner needs, points 3, 11.7 and 12: the minimum monthly wage a month, 30 per cent of it for a child, each request judged on its own
Cabinet Regulations No. 656 of 2015, point 2: the minimum monthly wage for normal working time is EUR 780 (as in force since 1 January 2026)
Cabinet Regulations No. 591 of 2008, Health Insurance of Foreigners, points 6, 7.2 and 9: what the policy covers, at least EUR 42,600 for a residence permit, for the whole stay
Cabinet Regulations No. 825 of 2006, point 2: the illness for which a residence permit is refused is tuberculosis in its active phase
Cabinet Regulations No. 133 of 2012 on the state fee for issuing identity documents, point 4 with a superscript 2 (not point 4.2): issuing a residence permit EUR 45 in 10 working days, EUR 80 in two

requirements.title: Funds for the minimum investment of EUR 50,000 in a company's share capital and for the EUR 10,000 payment to the state budget (the investment is EUR 100,000 in a larger company)
Not a citizen of Russia or Belarus, whose citizens have no right to this permit
Not a citizen of an EU or EEA state or of Switzerland, Latvia included: only third-country nationals may request this permit

assessments.title: EUR 50,000: a company with at most 50 employees and a yearly turnover or balance sheet of at most EUR 10 million; EUR 100,000: over 50 and over EUR 10 million, alone or with Latvian subsidiaries
The law says under the EUR 50,000 investment: permits for one company's share capital go to at most 10 foreigners, each having made the investment and paid EUR 10,000 to the state budget
The permit stays valid only while the company pays at least EUR 40,000 in taxes each reporting year (EUR 100,000 for the larger one, with its Latvian subsidiaries); refunded taxes do not count
No suspension in force: the Cabinet may suspend these permits for up to five years for nationals of third countries it names
The investment increases the share capital of a company or founds a new company
The company has no registered tax debt above EUR 150, unless the tax administration has extended the payment terms, or the decision setting the debt is not yet in force or is suspended
The earlier regulations ask on renewal, for an incomplete first reporting year, taxes averaging EUR 3,300 a month (EUR 8,300 for the larger company); the new law dropped the clause
A call (izsaukums) approved by the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs is needed, unless the applicant is the sole officer of a registered company with the right to represent it
Means of subsistence, judged case by case: the minimum monthly wage (EUR 780 in 2026) a month for each person who asks for a permit, and 30 per cent of it for a child
The policy pays at least for emergency medical help, in-patient treatment of a critical condition, transport to the nearest medical institution and transport home on serious illness or death
A valid health insurance policy is shown on receiving the permit; the insurer's limit of liability is at least EUR 42,600 for a residence permit, and the policy is valid for the whole expected stay
With the request: a valid travel document, the filled-in form, a photograph and a document proving the means of subsistence for the stay
A police certificate for those over 14, from the country of citizenship or residence where they stayed over 12 months; those who need no visa to enter Latvia do not hand it in

Family members add: a spouse, a copy of the marriage document; a child, copies of the documents proving kinship; a ward or a person under curatorship, the court ruling, taken over in Latvia if foreign
A child adds the consent of the parent not coming, notarised or signed before an Office or mission official, or, if the parent coming has daily care and no move limit is set, an authority's document
No conviction for an offence that Latvian law punishes as a crime, unless the record is expunged; for one committed abroad, a year after the sentence was served, five after a prison sentence
Not on the list of foreigners barred from entering Latvia and under no entry ban for the Schengen area
No tuberculosis in its active phase; a health certificate from a Latvian medical institution is handed in on receiving the permit
Filed, among other ways, at a Latvian mission outside Schengen, or inside it with that state's residence permit, at the Office when lawfully in Latvia, or online from abroad with a secure signature
The decision to grant this permit is valid for three months from the day it is taken, with no extension: the permit is collected in person in Latvia in that time, or the documents are filed again

dependents.title: Spouse, unless an EU, EEA or Swiss citizen, who needs no permit under this law
Children under 18 who have not married, unless EU, EEA or Swiss citizens, who need no permit; 18 or more: possible, under curatorship or, on renewal, if a minor at the first request
The spouse's children under 18 who have not married, unless EU, EEA or Swiss citizens, who need no permit; 18 or more: possible, under curatorship or, on renewal, if a minor at the first request

costs.title: Minimum investment in the share capital of a company within the small-company limits
One-off payment to the state budget for a first permit, paid before receiving it; refunded only in the Cabinet's cases, such as a written request within four months of the grant, no permit received
State fee for examining the principal's temporary residence permit request in 30 days: EUR 160 (EUR 280 in 10 working days, EUR 560 in 5)
State fee for examining each family member's temporary residence permit request in 30 days: EUR 160 (EUR 280 in 10 working days, EUR 560 in 5)
Payment to the state budget on receiving a repeated permit after five years of residence on this ground: EUR 2,000; a late request or a new investment object pays as a first permit: possible
State fee the inviter pays for a request to approve a call (izsaukums): EUR 10 when filed on the state portal's online form, EUR 17 when filed another way; none when no call is needed: possible
Added state fee for each person a request to approve a call includes: EUR 10, here for the principal; none when no call is needed: possible
Added state fee for each person a call request includes: EUR 10 for each family member; a request of their own also pays EUR 10 on the portal, or EUR 17; none when no call is needed: possible
State fee for issuing the principal's residence permit in 10 working days: EUR 45 (EUR 80 in two working days)
State fee for issuing each family member's residence permit in 10 working days: EUR 45 (EUR 80 in two working days)

durations.title: The Office's answer on the temporary residence permit request, within 30 days of accepting all the documents; up to four months when objective reasons prevent that
